findings.summary: The production named rows do not validate duplicate/malformed manifest keys or tuple/lock mismatches before launcher execution.
evidence: ops-d73-exact-nodes/suites.conf invokes the unchanged tools/p4-d73-pinned-launch.sh directly; it does not invoke check.py or another pre-dispatch validator.

scratch adversarial control: appending a duplicate format key to a valid manifest made the launcher return 0 and create duplicate.manifest, duplicate.request-id, duplicate.runmanifest, duplicate.preflight.log, duplicate.preflight.exit, duplicate.command, duplicate.body.log, and duplicate.body.exit.

scratch adversarial control: forcing preflight to exit 9 still created preflight-fail.manifest, preflight-fail.request-id, preflight-fail.runmanifest, preflight-fail.preflight.log, and preflight-fail.preflight.exit.
The launcher parser overwrites duplicate keys at line 19 and creates evidence at lines 60-73 before preflight at lines 75-141.
findings.required_fix: Add a production row/pre-launch guard that rejects duplicate and malformed keys plus tuple/lock mismatches before invoking the unchanged launcher and before any artifact directory is created; extend controls to execute every refusal through that row path and assert zero calls and zero artifacts.

findings.summary: The seven private controls do not test production refusal behavior for duplicate, malformed, or wrong-lock manifests.
evidence: test_recipe.py lines 248-260 only parse invalid manifests and assert an output path was never created; no launcher or row is invoked for those cases.
Only the separate source-SHA poison case invokes the parsed launcher command.
findings.required_fix: Route duplicate, malformed, wrong-source, and wrong-lock cases through the actual rendered named row and record zero launch calls and zero artifacts for each refusal.
